ns0:svg.ns0:title: Original synthetic images and two fixed filter responses
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Two separate idealized display images show interior vertical and horizontal synthetic stripes; they are not benchmark samples. Both edges remain inside the valid filter window. The input image has eight by eight pixels; each valid three by three filter produces six by six responses. Left-right and up-down derivative filters respond differently to orientation; blue and red denote opposite signs.
